item_name: Rothco Half Skull Reusable 3-Layer Polyester Face Mask
item_short_desc: Stay protected in style with Rothco’s Half Skull Reusable 3-Layer Polyester Face Mask. Crafted with a soft and stretchy 3-layer polyester construction, this face mask offers a comfortable fit that contours to your face, making it ideal for everyday wear. The bold Half Skull design gives the mask a unique look, while the adjustable nose bridge ensures a secure fit to minimize air leakage. Ear loops on both sides hold the mask securely in place, providing reliable coverage as you go about your day.
description: Stay protected in style with Rothco’s Half Skull Reusable 3-Layer Polyester Face Mask. Crafted with a soft and stretchy 3-layer polyester construction, this face mask offers a comfortable fit that contours to your face, making it ideal for everyday wear. The bold Half Skull design gives the mask a unique look, while the adjustable nose bridge ensures a secure fit to minimize air leakage. Ear loops on both sides hold the mask securely in place, providing reliable coverage as you go about your day. Measuring 7 inches wide by 5 inches high (3.25 inches at the sides), the mask comes in 2 sizes, Small/Medium and Large/X-Large, ensuring a proper fit for various face shapes. This reusable and washable face covering is perfect for daily use but is not a medical-grade or N95 mask. Add Rothco's Half Skull Face Mask to your daily essentials for a stylish and functional way to protect yourself.
